last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription allergic-rhinitis and nasal-care topics. The main query set returned 130 unique PubMed PMIDs, 130 fetched article records, and 130 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 15281472, 11799030, 40618891, 35776034, 39372205, 39121267, 33382385, 40005471, 39555052, 35099301, 29932206, 35462555, 26073163, and 34922567. Fourteen retained references were new to the database. Eight new entries across eight qualified topics retain numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects. Air purifier and HEPA filter topics were linked to the existing air-purifier-rhinitis-allergic-pos entry. Stinging nettle, spirulina, vitamin C, omega-3, local honey, saline spray, nasal lavage, yoga, breathing exercise, dust-mite encasement, allergen avoidance, steam inhalation, humidifier, green tea, EGCG, bromelain, ginger, turmeric, eucalyptus, and black-currant-seed-oil topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
